purpose: Out-of-pool negative control. The scrambled/control meaning must NOT reuse any varṇa→meaning mapping. Every gloss here is authored INDEPENDENTLY of track_g_varna_polarity_table_v2_named_vritti.json — none is a varṇa named_attribute, sphere gloss, binding gloss, or a near-synonym of one. This makes the control genuinely out-of-pool instead of a within-pool derangement (which, being drawn from the same 25 psychological/spiritual attributions, produces paraphrase-level near-synonyms and cannot separate authentic from control).
why_this_control: Prior B1.9 controls (completely_random_facet, same_plane_random_varna_facet, frequency_length_matched_facet) all draw content from the same 25-varṇa pool. Operator objection (verbatim intent): 'doctor studies medicine' vs 'medicine is study done by doctors' — a within-pool swap keeps the same meaning, so there is nothing to differentiate. The out-of-pool control removes the varṇa mapping entirely from the control side.
register_caveat_honest: These glosses are concrete/sensory/natural/craft/geometric — a DIFFERENT register from the varṇa moral-psychological attributions. So a positive delta against THIS control could reflect register difference (abstract-psychological vs concrete-sensory), not varṇa-specific meaning. Therefore the out-of-pool contrast MUST be read together with the within-pool controls: authentic beating out-of-pool but NOT beating within-pool would indicate register-appropriateness, not varṇa specificity. Element-word overlaps with the tattva glosses (water/jala, fire/agni, earth/kshiti, ether, sun/day/night/light/dark) were deliberately excluded to avoid accidental pool contact.
selection_rule: Frozen before run. Sampled deterministically (fixed seed, K per item) with NO reference to d_auth or to whether authentic is closer. No gloss added or removed based on any outcome.
